# 7 Paradigmas
## Proyecto Lenguajes de Programacion
This is Benny Marcano's Computer Language class' MidTerm project.

It includes 7 programs that vary in the programming languages they were created on, on 7 different logistical paradigms.

Imperative: Prime finder written in Python (Pyscript)
Functional: Calculator written in Elm
Logical: Family reasoner written in Prolog
OOP: blackjack written in C++
Extra: Music hub written in JavaScript
Extra 2: Game review program written in JavaScript
CV: written with JavaScript

*Most of the code used was generated by Claude.AI, with modifications done by me.
